headline: Executive order directs federal efforts to improve safety and security at facilities that make, store, or handle chemicals.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Obama in 2013, directs the federal government to take steps to make chemical facilities safer and more secure. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies, and deadlines it sets cannot be confirmed from the source material.

who_it_affects.how: They may face changes in federal safety and security oversight of their sites.

who_it_affects.group: People who live or work near chemical facilities
who_it_affects.how: The order aims to lower the risk of chemical accidents or attacks that could affect them.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 1, 2013; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
